BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.

2. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

4. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

9. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

10. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

14. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

15. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

16. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
